sanskrit_verse:
अनन्यविषयं कृत्वा मनोबुद्धिस्मृतीन्द्रियम् ।
ध्येय आत्मा स्थितो योऽसौ हृदये दीपवत् प्रभुः ॥
transliteration:
ananyaviṣayaṃ kṛtvā manobuddhismṛtīndriyam | 
dhyeya ātmā sthito yo'sau hṛdaye dīpavat prabhuḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: When consciousness is singularly directed, purified of mind-buddhi-memory-sense instruments, the Self, radiant like a lamp within the heart, becomes the sole meditative object and the sovereign abode of realization.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates in unified consciousness, not fragmented mental constructs
Causation arises from alignment with the Self, not external behavioral triggers
Capacity-based responsibility stems from awareness, not sensory impulse
Restoration logic operates through inner illumination, not outer correction
Consciousness alignment supersedes cognitive fragmentation in determining lawful action
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent's cognition is unified AND sense-instruments are stilled THEN legal capacity is maximal
IF mental fragmentation dominates THEN adjudicative weight of actions decreases proportionally
IF self-awareness governs behavior THEN no corrective enforcement is required
IF consciousness is obscured THEN initiate restoration protocol through stillness practices
IF dhyana-state is achieved THEN decision-making aligns inherently with Dharma
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, intent derived from unified consciousness carries highest juridical weight. Mental fragmentation or sensory impulsivity reduces culpability index. Courts must assess not just actus reus but the level of self-awareness present during action.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that true causality lies in the state of consciousness at time of action. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows that outer acts follow inner illumination or its absence. Thus, proportional responsibility maps to awareness-level, not outcome severity. Non-punitive reality rule affirms that misalignment corrects through Self-revelation, not judicial penalty.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate śamana-dhyāna completion process to restore cognitive unity
Assign pratipakṣa-bhāvanā until buddhi stabilizes in Self-reference
Implement mauna-vrata to withdraw sense-instrument agitation
Establish hṛdaya-dīpa awareness practice until consciousness radiates clarity
Verify sthita-prajña condition before reintegration into societal function
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this Dharma stands established: Consciousness alone is the ultimate judge, Self-realization the only law, and illumination the sole enforcement. All else is alignment.
